generation_rule: Generate the literal product of support, identity, partition, multiplicity, weight, prediction, record and extension forms; decide all 256 candidates only from admitted exact state, observation, counting and thermodynamic carrier laws.
grammar_boundary: Every nonempty finite generated chemical-state tuple and its complete disjoint observation partition, with one-state finite successor closure. Completed infinity and continuum ensembles are outside the grammar. External structure is tested on all 330 direct CaH+ state rows and all 57 NIST water calorimetric rows.
